biotools.summary: BioVizSeq is an R package designed for visualizing the types and distribution of elements within bio-sequences, offering flexibility and user-friendly visualization capabilities. It includes a novel geom layer (geom_rrect()) and supports various data formats like GFF/GTF, MEME, and Plantcare.
